title: kate-ui: build the diagnostics rows and the underline spans
summary: kate-ui gains the kate-lsp dependency and diagnostics.rs. diagnostic_rows resolves anchored diagnostics to sorted rows for the pane and drops stale ones. underlines_for_lines clips each diagnostic to the visible lines as column spans with a severity. The window paints both in the next packets.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add kate-lsp to the kate-ui dependencies with the comment and run cargo update -p kate-ui so Cargo.lock gains the edge and the kate-lsp crates only. Create diagnostics.rs with the SPDX header and add mod diagnostics; to lib.rs with the dead_code attribute. Use kate_lsp::diagnostics::diagnostic_span and buf.line_col. The test underlines_clip_to_each_line builds ab\ncd\nef, anchors one error from line 0 column 1 to line 2 column 1, and asserts underlines_for_lines for 0..3 gives three underlines: (0, 1, 2), (1, 0, 2), (2, 0, 1), and that diagnostic_rows gives one row at line 0 column 1. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: diagnostics::tests::underlines_clip_to_each_line
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because diagnostics.rs does not exist. After the change a three-line diagnostic becomes three underlines and one pane row.
